en.summary: Ask Codex to fix one small issue, and it cycles through edit, full test run, edit again. Half a day disappears, and your quota and patience hit bottom together. Worse: a pile of tests pass, but hitting run still throws an error. The author offers a set of guardrails you can drop straight into AGENTS.md. If you use Codex or Claude Code regularly and keep getting slowed down by these self-loops, it's worth adjusting your rules once and giving it a try.

items_all.summary: 作者这篇笔记梳理了快手企业 AI 落地经验，给出了一个可落地的解法：先沉淀员工经验为共享能力，再重构分工；以小团队模式压缩交付链路，搭配需求风险分级的智能质检体系，同时搭建统一底座与积分机制管控成本。这套兼顾试点试错和企业治理的思路，可以帮大小团队避开 Agent 孤岛、空转、质量失控等问题。

en.title: The best take on AI Native thinking I've heard this year—sincere and refreshingly down-to-earth.
en.summary: The author's notes distill Kuaishou's enterprise AI deployment experience into a practical playbook: first codify employee expertise into shared capabilities, then restructure how work is divided; use small teams to shorten delivery chains, pair that with an intelligent QA system that grades requirements by risk, and build a unified foundation plus a credit/points mechanism to control costs. This approach balances pilot experimentation with enterprise governance, helping teams of all sizes avoid Agent silos, idle spinning, and quality loss of control.

items_all.title: 从OpenClaw，怎么走到了Super Agent？
items_all.summary: 最近最火的应该是DeepSeek Harness产品团队发布的Super Agent了。很多人说没看懂，也有很多人说，这就是自己工作的日常。作者这篇文章就是想跟大家聊一下，过去这一年观察到的Agent产品工具的演进逻辑。可能从这个过程回顾，有机会帮助我们更好理解，发生了什么？为什么走到了现在。

en.title: From OpenClaw to Super Agent: how did we get here?
en.summary: The buzziest thing lately is probably Super Agent, released by the DeepSeek Harness product team. Many people say they don't get it; many others say it's just their day-to-day work. This article aims to talk through the evolution logic of Agent product tools observed over the past year. Looking back at that process may help us better understand what happened—and why we ended up here.

items_all.title: 开源我这折腾了1年的「Agent自动化系统」，愿所有人都能感受Agent的魅力。
items_all.summary: 卡兹克将自用的Agent自动化系统重构后，开源了Agent-Autoloop。整套架构采用插件化设计，事件、模型、通知通道均可自由接入，适配绝大多数主流Agent。文中还展示了大量可直接复用的自动化场景，个人和团队都能快速搭建自主流转、按需人工审批的智能工作流。

en.title: After a year of tinkering, I'm open-sourcing my Agent automation system — I hope everyone gets to experience the magic of Agents.
en.summary: Kazik has open-sourced Agent-Autoloop after rebuilding the Agent automation system he uses himself. The architecture is plugin-based throughout: events, models, and notification channels can all be plugged in freely, and it works with most mainstream Agents. The article also showcases a large set of directly reusable automation scenarios, so individuals and teams can quickly build intelligent workflows that run autonomously and call for human approval on demand.
